title: UI: SVG icon set in SolidCraft's style - operations, tools, tabs, tree, status (part of #655)

body:
## Goal

Give CamCraft a full, original icon set in SolidCraft's style, as SVG, so it fits the SolidCraft look (#655).

- **Format:** SolidCraft's kit draws icons from SVG through a host-installed icon set (`icon_svg.rs`; tangency-labs/solidcraft#14399). CamCraft today has 37 PNGs at 32×32 in `assets/ui/`, referenced from `crates/ui/src/egui_app/icons.rs`.
- **Who draws what:** generic chrome (New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Delete, menus, window controls) comes from SolidCraft's kit. **CamCraft supplies only the machining-specific icons below.**

**Licensing (AGENTS.md "Assets"):**
- Every icon is drawn original, or taken from an MIT, ISC, Apache-2.0 or BSL set with no attribution required (Tabler stays the primary source).
- Nothing is adapted from HSMWorks or Fusion material.
- Licence texts go in `assets/ui/LICENSES.md`.

**Style:** match SolidCraft's stroke weight, grid and corner radius, and read clearly at 16 px, in light and dark themes and in every colour-vision mode.

## Checklist

### 1. Operations with no icon of their own (22)
**2D milling**
- [ ] Adaptive 2D (adaptive clearing)
- [ ] 2D Offset
- [ ] Engrave
- [ ] 2D Chamfer
- [ ] Circular (circular pocket or boss)

**Holes**
- [ ] Thread milling
- [ ] Bore

**3D milling**
- [ ] 3D Pocket (3D roughing)
- [ ] Deburr

**Turning, all missing**
- [ ] Facing
- [ ] Profile rough
- [ ] Profile finish
- [ ] Groove rough
- [ ] Groove finish
- [ ] Part-off
- [ ] Threading (lathe)
- [ ] Chamfering (lathe)
- [ ] Taper turning
- [ ] Multi-pass turning
- [ ] Form turning
- [ ] Boring (lathe)

### 2. Operations using a generic stand-in, to redraw (5)
- [ ] Face (today a "layers" glyph)
- [ ] Contour (today an outlined square)
- [ ] Pocket (today a "container" box)
- [ ] Slot (today a minus sign)
- [ ] Trace (today a "route" line)

### 3. Existing original icons, to convert to SVG in the new style (12)
- [ ] Drill
- [ ] Probe
- [ ] 3D Finish
- [ ] 5-axis Contour
- [ ] 5-axis Parallel
- [ ] Flow 5D
- [ ] Swarf
- [ ] Advanced Swarf
- [ ] Rotary Contour
- [ ] Rotary Parallel
- [ ] Rotary Offset
- [ ] Multi-axis Rough
- [ ] Multi-axis Contour

### 4. Tool types, for the tool library and picker; none have icons today (12)
- [ ] End mill
- [ ] Ball nose
- [ ] Bull nose
- [ ] Drill
- [ ] Tap
- [ ] Boring bar
- [ ] Turning insert
- [ ] Grooving blade
- [ ] Threading insert
- [ ] Form tool
- [ ] Taper tool
- [ ] Probe

### 5. Workspace tabs, SolidCraft's tab strip with an accent per tab (8)
- [ ] Setup
- [ ] 2D
- [ ] 3D
- [ ] Drill / Holes
- [ ] Turn
- [ ] Multi-axis
- [ ] Simulate
- [ ] Post

### 6. Setup and operation tree rows (7)
- [ ] Setup
- [ ] Part / model (today the cube)
- [ ] Stock (today a box)
- [ ] Work offset / WCS (today the transform glyph)
- [ ] Fixture (convert)
- [ ] Machine (new)
- [ ] Operation group / folder (new)

### 7. Operation status badges, small overlays on a tree row (4)
`OpStatus` is `Never`, `Ok` or `Stale`; the warning badge is new.
- [ ] Not generated
- [ ] OK
- [ ] Stale (needs regenerating)
- [ ] Warning or refused (generated, but refused or flagged)

### 8. CamCraft-specific actions (7)
- [ ] Generate
- [ ] Post
- [ ] Simulate
- [ ] Show toolpaths
- [ ] Hide toolpaths
- [ ] Frame all
- [ ] Debug info

**Totals:** about 60 new drawings plus about 20 conversions.
- New: 22 operations, 5 stand-ins redrawn, 12 tools, 8 tabs, 2 new tree rows, 4 badges and the action set.
- Converted: the 12 existing originals, plus the existing tree and action icons.

## Done means

- **Every item above is an SVG** in `assets/ui/` (or the kit's icon-set layout), registered in `icons.rs`, or in the host icon set the kit installs once solidcraft-ui-kit lands.
- **Every operation kind** (`OpType`), **tool kind** (`ToolKindDto`), tab, tree row, status and action draws its own icon.
- **Licences:** `assets/ui/LICENSES.md` covers anything taken from a licensed set.
- **Tests:** the structural UI test asserts every `OpType` and tool kind maps to an icon, and no PR changes a pixel snapshot (they're refreshed at the cut).

## Order

- **Can start now:** sections 1–4 and 6–8. They're icons, independent of the egui bump (#658).
- **Lands with the theme or kit:** section 5 (tabs) arrives with #659 or the kit's tab strip.

Part of #655
